advice.title: Site etiquette
advice.body: Follow current on-site notices. At the Mahabodhi complex, mobile phones, cameras and electronic gadgets are listed as prohibited — use TrueWay before entry or only where devices are allowed.

advice.title: Heat and hill walks
advice.body: Rajgir ascents need water, daylight margin and confirmed route access. Offline seasonal notes are generic awareness, not a live weather window.
